observed: the model interface explicitly distinguishes StableModel, BraveConsequences, and CautiousConsequences
consequence inspection can represent true, false, or unknown
records.derived_pattern: When multiple admissible models or explanations remain, distinguish claims supported by at least one model from claims supported by every surviving model.
records.behavioral_consequence: Use POSSIBLE/BRAVE versus NECESSARY/CAUTIOUS claim status when uncertainty is model-plural; do not flatten existence of one consistent explanation into universal support.

observed: models declare always properties for safety/invariants and sometimes properties for reachable outcomes
the checker searches for counterexamples to always-properties and examples for sometimes-properties
discoveries are represented as explicit paths/traces of system steps
records.derived_pattern: A hostile review is stronger when a claim is translated into an explicit invariant/reachability property and the system searches for a concrete counterexample trace.
records.behavioral_consequence: For substantial architecture claims, state at least one invariant or reachability property and preserve a concrete falsifying trace when found, rather than relying only on prose critique.

observed: recorded events are immutable and carry globally ordered event number, stream identity/version, causation id, correlation id, metadata, and creation time
aggregate state is event sourced and may use snapshots, with snapshot versions controlling whether older snapshots are ignored during state rebuild
records.derived_pattern: Mutable current state should be reconstructible from an immutable, causally annotated event history when continuity or auditability matters.
records.behavioral_consequence: For material Sol state changes, preserve append-only change events/provenance in addition to current summaries; summaries remain convenience views, not the only historical evidence.

observed: Double Machine Learning is presented as treatment-effect estimation under an explicit observed-confounders assumption
predictive nuisance tasks are estimated separately from the final treatment-effect model
cross-fitting and orthogonality are used to protect the final estimate from nuisance-estimation error under stated conditions
records.derived_pattern: Predictive accuracy and causal effect estimation are different evidence tasks; causal language needs explicit identification assumptions and separation of nuisance prediction from the target causal claim.
records.behavioral_consequence: Do not upgrade correlation, prediction, or mechanistic plausibility into causal language without an explicit causal design/assumption set; label causal identification separately from predictive evidence.

observed: search evolves populations of expressions rather than one candidate trajectory
the output exposes an accuracy/complexity Pareto front and allows selecting any candidate rather than only the default
the guidance explicitly notes evolutionary search lacks conventional convergence and can jump families after long search
records.derived_pattern: For open-ended hypothesis search, preserve a diverse frontier of non-dominated candidates and explicit tradeoffs instead of prematurely collapsing to one favored explanation.
records.behavioral_consequence: When several live hypotheses trade explanatory fit against complexity/risk, preserve the frontier and report why a candidate is retained or discarded; do not treat current best as converged truth.
